summary: Legend Biotech filed a Form 6-K to announce a late-breaking oral presentation of preliminary Phase 1 clinical data for LB2501 at the EHA 2026 Congress. The filing includes a press release and an abstract but contains no special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. It is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results, not a corporate transaction or strategic review. Thus, it does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
